theorem.synthesis: O(n) BFS/DFS on labelled Schreier graph
theorem.consequence: Three canonical exact-one witnesses, one per Z3 phase.
theorem.representation_equivalence: Phase exists iff a one-dimensional G=<P,Q> subrepresentation contributes a zero-mode of I+P+Q.
theorem.abelianization: Equivalently there is chi:G->Z3 with chi(P)=1, chi(Q)=-1 and the point stabilizer contained in ker chi.

easy_counterfamily.lesson: Large nullity plus noncommutativity is not a hardness signature.

firewall.statement: Irreducible decomposition block-diagonalizes the rational operator but the {-1,2} coordinate alphabet does not factor across representation blocks.
firewall.required_next: Any higher-representation algorithm needs a polynomial exact alphabet-lift/coupling theorem.

active_gate.target: Poly exact contraction/solver for phase-inconsistent higher-dimensional nonabelian zero modes with exact {-1,2} lift.
